title: AI Interview Prep Tool
description:
Preparing for your interview can make the biggest difference between getting an interview and getting an offer.

I don’t want to leave that to chance.

Anyone else try AI for interview prep?

#interviewtips #interviewing #aitools #aitips
transcript: I have a really big interview coming up and I wanted to research some interview prep services from online and locally and these are the prices they're talking about 300 an hour for one call and then I remember this tool called teal that does interview prep for free the interview prep is an AI tool that's already in the tracker so it has your resume and the job description the tool is conversational so it mimics like a real interview hi mine thanks for taking the time to interview today how are you I'm well thank you how are you then after the interview it gave me detailed feedback on every single question and answer that we went over there's no need to spend hundreds of dollars on interview prep when you have free tools like this available to you at any time
